title: Parametric Staircase Geometry
description: Reusable SVG straight-flight staircase geometry with derived riser height, going count, total run, width, and geometric pitch labels.
learningObjectives: Compute individual riser height from total rise and number of risers.
Relate a straight stair flight's number of goings to its riser count and horizontal run.
Read rise, going, width, total rise, run, and geometric pitch without treating the graphic as a code-compliance check.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: Candidate geometry uses explicit stair-count conventions and independent arithmetic spot-checks. Independent browser, accessibility, and release engineering review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Reserved buildings-agent task bld-staircase; implemented as original dependency-free SVG/DOM source.
